# Diff lane findings — OURS (`work/civic/cfmbt/`) vs THEIRS (`globalbondaudit.grok.me`)

**Method note:** both THEIRS pages fetched successfully (full content, not just meta descriptions). OURS read: `work/civic/ccfmbt` corrected below — paths actually read:
- `work/civic/cfmbt/app/index.html` (208 lines)
- `work/civic/cfmbt/data/sources.json` (20 lines)
- `work/civic/cfmbt/forms/self-disclosure.md` (49 lines)
- `work/civic/cfmbt/legal/privacy-posture.md` (64 lines)

THEIRS: `https://globalbondaudit.grok.me/` (home) and `https://globalbondaudit.grok.me/method`. THEIRS nav also advertises `/compare`, `/attach`, `/expansion`, `/example`, `/disclosure` — **not fetched** (out of scope for this task), so any claim about their disclosure numbers below is scoped to the two pages read.

---

## 0. Shared core (common ground — both builds agree)

| Element | OURS | THEIRS |
|---|---|---|
| Spine: vote / yearly fund hit / advisor file / threshold rule | `index.html` §1–§4, method blockquote :171–174 | home cards 01–03, `/method` lede |
| Three honesty labels `we-have-a-record / not-proven / people-disagree` | `index.html` :16–18; `sources.json` `allowed_scores` | `/method` "Honesty labels" |
| Basis `Evidence / Inference / Assumption`; Forecast never Record; "software never auto-truths"; "incomplete beats fake-complete"; "human final call" | `index.html` :187–200; `sources.json` `allowed_basis` | `/method` integrity list + honesty labels |
| No natural-person holder list; do not pierce the book (Cede & Co./DTC) | `index.html` :155–160; `privacy-posture.md` ¶1–2 | `/method` Layer B + refusals; home lede |
| CJEU joined cases C-37/20 & C-601/20, 22 Nov 2022 | `sources.json` SRC-CJEU-2022; `privacy-posture.md` ¶1 | `/method` "Book-entry wall" + citations |
| Over-collection refusal: no home addresses / tax IDs / account numbers / exact position size | `privacy-posture.md` ¶6; `self-disclosure.md` :3, :35 | `/method` refusals |
| Blank-until-primary-record discipline; no invented dollars/votes/firms/CUSIPs | `index.html` :19, :69, :92 | home counter `0`; `/method` integrity |
| Fund-level sunlight ≠ naming individuals | `index.html` :159 | home lede + card 03 |
| Transaction parties (underwriter / advisor / bond counsel / paying agent), blank until record | `index.html` :82–87 | `/method` Layer B |

The shared phrasing ("Software never auto-truths. Incomplete beats fake-complete. Human final call.") indicates common spec lineage — the diff is coverage, not philosophy.
